source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The logging patch reports GECKO_PATH, cwd and mach existence after changing directory and immediately before two Rust mach commands. Existence logging does not repair or establish an executable checkout. The fixed accepted main instead calls check_gecko_checkout before the Rust commands, and run_cmd separately handles OSError before reading a subprocess result. Those are later phases, not effects of the logging-only patch. The guard text suggests a tag-only revision; it is not proof of the historical cause.
title: UpdateBot path diagnostics are separate from checkout and process-start guards
